column1: # CLAIMS.tsv — EVERY PUBLISHED NUMBER, ITS VALUE, AND THE COMMAND THAT REPRODUCES IT.
# ⛔⛔ WHY THIS FILE EXISTS.  Measured 2026-09-11 (D202): all seven headline
# quantities in `docs/TACAS-PRICING.md` §1 were CORRECT and not one stated its
# denominator.  Re-deriving them with the obvious command gives 23,352 / 618 / 59
# against the published 18,824 / 616 / 55 — because `lean_lines` excludes
# `Main.lean`'s 4,390 and `design_documents` excludes `docs/seals/`.  The author
# of that day's "the population is the claim" lesson got three of seven wrong.
# ⇒ A CORRECT NUMBER WITH AN UNSTATED DENOMINATOR FAILS REPRODUCTION EXACTLY LIKE
#   A WRONG ONE, AND FAILS WORSE: the author defends it, the reproducer cannot see
#   the disagreement, and both are right.
# ⭐ THIS IS `CLAIM-2`'s STATED PRECONDITION, BUILT: *"the first task is a format,
# not a gate."*  The denominators were prose; a gate over prose would have been a
# third copy of the mistake wearing a fix's clothes.  Here each denominator IS the
# command, so the claim and its population cannot drift apart — there is nothing
# to keep in step.
# ⭐ AND IT IS G5's ARTIFACT-EVALUATION SPINE.  TACAS AE asks a stranger to
# reproduce every claim.  With this file that is one command, and the reviewer
# reads the derivation rather than trusting it.
# ⛔ THERE IS DELIBERATELY NO `--update`.  A gate that can rewrite its expected
# values from the thing it measures is not a gate; it is a recorder that always
# agrees.  When a number legitimately moves, a human edits this file and the
# change is visible in the diff, with its reason in the commit.
#   [[feedback-widening-a-gate-needs-a-second-source]]
# ⚠️ SCOPE, STATED SO THE FILE IS NOT READ AS COMPLETE.  These are the claims that
# had NO gate.  The six COVERAGE numbers (mnemonics, forms, roster rows, machine
# forms, spellings) are gated independently and far more strongly by
# `scripts/claimed_forms.py`, which derives them from TWO sources that are not
# derived from each other and fails CI when the prose disagrees.  They are NOT
# duplicated here: a second, weaker derivation of an already-gated number is a
# duplicate born in agreement.
# ⛔⛔ LIVE vs FROZEN, AND THE DISTINCTION IS LOAD-BEARING.  `TACAS-PRICING.md` §1
# states its numbers **AT `7bb57ee`** — a measurement about a sha, which is
# legitimate and correctly labelled, and which MUST NOT be re-derived at HEAD.
# THIS file carries the LIVE value, re-derived every run.  Two rows already
# differ (`decisions` 205 vs the frozen 200; `design_documents` 59 vs 55) and
# their `appears_in` says so rather than pointing at a file that prints a
# different number.
# ⇒ 🔑 A MANIFEST THAT CITES A FROZEN SNAPSHOT AS IF IT WERE LIVE MANUFACTURES
#   THE EXACT CROSS-DOCUMENT CONTRADICTION IT EXISTS TO PREVENT.  Caught while
#   writing this file, one edit after building the gate for it.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated):  id  value  command  appears_in
# The command must print EXACTLY the value on stdout, and is run from the repo root.
